body:
Thank you for the full-log transcription. I am submitting a **provisional** research audit of the Childs log, based on the transcription and published keys. The work was AI-assisted and each proposed reading was compared with matched random-key controls.

**Important caveat:** I have not yet checked these results against the Childs page images. Please treat the following as proposed classifications/readings pending that source check.

## Duplicate intercepts and identifications

- I find 25 entries marked unsolved that appear to be second intercepts of solved transmissions. Their coverage against the identified partner is 0.50–1.00, while 400 random pairs of real ciphertexts reached at most 0.071.
- **p155E (Childs p.152; Schmeh #7)** matches the last 104 symbols of solved p139B: 88 of 102 readable symbols agree at a fixed offset. It should be reclassified as a repetition, rather than attacked as an independent ciphertext.
- **p192A (Childs p.189; Schmeh #20)** appears to be a damaged copy of p188_.2: a gap-aware alignment gives 63 matches against 16 mismatches. The recovered reading is: *Gestellung Auto unmöglich. Befehl abwarten. I.V. Rente.*

## Proposed readings

| Entry | Proposed status | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| p0924, part 2 | read | Continuation of the 1 Nov OSM de LP message: Nikolaev, the railway situation, and Captain Joel / Fech Odessa. |
| p110D | read | OHL orders Ia 104660, 11118, and 1?127 acknowledged by OKM. |
| p190G | read | *Bitte sofort Bescheid, ob Verbindung mit Armee Mackensen einwandfrei.* |
| p072A | read, name uncertain | Liaison officer sent to Tiflis with OHL agreement. |
| p125B | read in part | Radio reply requested concerning employment in the Ministry of Trade / demobilisation. |
| p189B3 | read in part | Men leaving for home on their own authority; OHL Ia. |

Two entries also appear already read by Childs in 1918: p101B2+p101B is RICHI 266, and p119A1 is RICHI 222.

The full per-entry sheets preserve the printed and repaired transcriptions, key, exact edits, letter-stream decryption, reading, and English translation. I can provide those sheets and the reproduction scripts for review. I would particularly appreciate comparison against the page images and any correction to this proposed status table.
title: Proposed duplicate classifications, two identifications, and ADFGVX readings from the Childs log
